decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith Planning Statement, Structural Statement, Design and Access Statement, Tree Report, Flood Risk Assessment, Heritage Statement, Photo Montage x2, Drawing Numbers 698P100, 698P101, 698P102, 698P103, 698P104, 698P209, 698P208, 698P207, 698P206, 698P205, 698P204, 698P203, 698P202, 698PO1, 698PO2, 698PO3, 698PO4, 68PO5, 698PO6, 698PO7, 698PO8, 698PO9, 698P10, 698P11, 698P12, 698p12A, 698P13, 698P14, 698P15, 698P16, 698P17, 698P18,  698P19, 698P500 received 20/09/12and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted including all bricks, tiles, coping/capping stones, roof panels/roofinghave been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.
Condition : 5 - Where possible, and in the case of intervention in original walls, nib and/or downstands should be retained to show the historical past of the building.

Condition : 6 - The finish of the walls to be rendered on the studio and main house shall match the render of the existing building on the site in terms of colour and texture and shall thereafter be so maintained, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Such rendering and colouring shall be completed within one month of the development hereby permitted being first brought into use, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 7 - The rainwater goods and vents utilised in the development hereby permitted shall be cast iron and coloured black and
thereafter so maintained.
Condition : 8 - All new window frames, glazing bars and external door frames shall be of timber construction, white painted, with (if any) trickle vents concealed and thereafter so maintained.
Condition : 9 - The external face of the frame to all new windows shall be set in reveals to match those of existing windows of the principal building on the site.

Condition : 10 - Details of the window frames (including the rooflight) to be utilised in the development hereby permitted, including samples if so required, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced. Such details shall indicate, at a scale of not less
than 1:20, the longitudinal and cross-sectional detailing, cill and lintol detailing, and means of opening. The window frames shall be installed in accordance with the approved details and thereafter so maintained.

Condition : 11 - Details of the design of all doors to be utilised in the development hereby permitted shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced and all external doors used in the development shall conform to the details so approved.

Condition : 12 - No works shall take place until full details of the proposed shutters, timber panelling, pergola,  spiral staircase and fire surround including scaled drawings are approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The works shall be implemented in strict accordance with the agreed details and maintained as such thereafter.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and erection of a new roof extension to the main house and alterations to the studio at the rear of the property to provide a self-contained unit with alterations to the rear elevation, erection of a two storey extension to the garden side and installation of an external spiral staircase including internal alterations to the main house and the studio.
